claude_code.description: External Claude Code CLI for an independent implementation or review when using a separate provider adds value.

kimi_code.description: External Kimi Code CLI. Choose it from configured capability and recent measured execution results, not from task keywords.

codex.description: External ephemeral Codex CLI. Prefer native Codex subagents for ordinary delegation; use this only when isolated CLI execution adds value.

pi.description: External Pi CLI using its configured model. Treat it as an independent execution option and use recent measured results when choosing.

analyst.description: Use for a bounded, independent requirements or architecture analysis when a separate view adds value. Return findings and tradeoffs; do not implement the change.

reviewer.description: Use for independent verification of completed work against the user's request and observable test evidence. Report actionable findings; do not reimplement the change.
